message.content: {"ranking": [{"id": "patch_51df04ca4c8e", "failure_port": "o_sck", "source_line": 5494, "mechanism": "Gate the critical condition (startup_hold || byte_accepted) with i_cs (chip-select asserted). The divergence begins at cycle 101 where o_sck=1 (actual) vs 0 (expected) — exactly when the first WB command is accepted and the SPI engine must start clocking. i_cs is the top-level arbiter; if low the engine must hold CS de-asserted and SCK inactive. Adding i_cs prevents spurious state transitions when the bus is not selected."}, {"id": "patch_04bb6f387ef0", "failure_port": "o_sck", "source_line": 4826, "mechanism": "Qualify the startup hold transition with !i_bus_grant. The failure at cycle 101 shows o_sck=1 when arbitration is required (OPT_SPI_ARBITRATION=1) and i_bus_grant=0. The startup counter decrements on SCK rising edges; gating with !i_bus_grant stops the clock from running before the bus grant arrives, matching the expected o_sck=0."}, {"id": "patch_88b084625589", "failure_port": "o_sck", "source_line": 4843, "mechanism": "Qualify the absolute-value startup_counter condition with startup_hold. During the first 75 clocks startup_hold=1; the |startup_counter expression can spuriously evaluate true and drive state logic. Adding startup_hold ensures the gate is only active while the startup timer is genuinely running, keeping o_sck=0 until cycle 99+75."}, {"id": "patch_475847e36fa1", "failure_port": "o_sck", "source_line": 5494, "mechanism": "Gate (startup_hold || byte_accepted) with !i_cs (CS de-asserted). The trace first divergence at cycle 101 coincides with i_cs=1 in the test stimulus; however the original code allows state advance when !i_cs is false. Adding !i_cs forces the engine to stay idle when CS is de-asserted, holding o_sck=0 as expected."}, {"id": "patch_d6528483d379", "failure_port": "o_sck", "source_line": 4826, "mechanism": "Gate the startup counter decrement with !i_cs. When i_cs=0 the SPI bus is inactive; the startup timer must not count SCK edges. The observed o_sck=1 at cycle 101 implies the counter advanced prematurely. Adding !i_cs freezes the startup counter until CS asserts, aligning o_sck with expected 0."}, {"id": "patch_5047f8bbe194", "failure_port": "o_sck", "source_line": 4843, "mechanism": "Qualify |startup_counter with i_bus_grant. Arbitration is enabled; the first bus grant appears at cycle 97 but the startup counter was already expiring. Gating with i_bus_grant prevents the startup logic from generating SCK toggles before the grant, keeping o_sck=0 until the grant cycle aligns."}, {"id": "patch_4e8a7b689e9c", "failure_port": "o_sck", "source_line": 5582, "mechanism": "Qualify the !r_z_counter branch with startup_hold. The counter logic runs every cycle; during startup_hold the r_z_counter should not gate SPI clocking. The divergence at cycle 101 shows SCK high when it should be low. Adding startup_hold suppresses this path until startup completes."}, {"id": "patch_f6b82ff16547", "failure_port": "o_sck", "source_line": 5582, "mechanism": "Qualify the !r_z_counter branch with !startup_hold (explicit inverse). This is the logical dual of patch_4e8a7b689e9c; it ensures the counter decrement path is only taken after startup finishes. The failure at cycle 101 on o_sck indicates the path was taken during startup."}], "explanation": "All divergences manifest as o_sck=1 (actual) vs 0 (expected) starting at cycle 101 — the first cycle where a Wishbone command is accepted and the low-level SPI engine should begin clocking. The root cause is missing qualification of state-transition gates by bus arbitration (i_bus_grant), chip-select (i_cs), and the startup-hold flag. The ranked patches each add one of these missing qualifiers to the exact condition that the static dependency graph shows drives the SCK output. The top-ranked patch (patch_51df04ca4c8e) gates the main command-accept condition with i_cs, which is the highest-level bus arbiter. The next three target the startup-counter decrement logic that runs during the 75-cycle startup window. The remaining patches guard the r_z_counter branch that can also advance the clock counter. Together they form a coherent barrier preventing premature SCK generation."}
